title: Teto X Egen
synopsis: Ha-Seon, a “workaholic” for whom her company and job are her whole life, and Seon-Ho, a “homebody” whose world consists only of his home and his cat. These two seemed as unlikely to cross paths as parallel lines. But not only are they assigned to the same task force, it turns out they’re actually neighbors, and their daily lives begin to get tangled up. Just when things are getting complicated, Seon-Ho’s first love shows up…! What will become of this precarious yet strangely thrilling relationship between two people who lived in completely different worlds? (Source: Millie, translated)

synopsis: “These three could destroy the country all by themselves if they wanted… But there was one thing they just couldn't get.” For the three strongest adventurers in the world, finding a man strong enough to be with them is a herculean task. title: Ring ni Kakero
synopsis: Takane Kiku and Takane Ryuji are the children of a legendary world contender boxer. Kiku, the daughter seems to have inherited her father's boxing sense and tries to teach Ryuji to become a world contender. However, Ryuji hates boxing and gets picked on. After Kiku and Ryuji leave their hometown for Tokyo, Ryuji eventually learns to discover a passion for boxing after an encounter with a boxing prodigy, Kenzaki Jun. This will eventually lead him to learn crazy moves and out of this world opponents to become one of Japan's top junior boxers. (Source: Anime News Network)
